name: Uploaded media
description: Uploaded media capabilities. Includes List images in the media library, Step 1 of the presigned upload flow: reserves a pending image and returns a presigned URL to POST the file to directly, bytes never pass through this API, Step 2 of the presigned upload flow: verifies the object POSTed to the upload_url, sniffs its real content type, and activates it — after this it appears in the library and is publicly servable., When object storage is available this API allows upload of media which can be used, for example, in text cards on dashboards.
